component.name: Among Terminal
component.summary: Organize live terminals in project workspaces

description.p: A native GNOME terminal multiplexer with project workspaces and flexible pane layouts.

ul.li: Split, resize and move terminal panes while background workspaces stay alive.
Restore workspace layouts and known directories into fresh shells.
Customize status panels with independent optional plugins.

screenshot.caption: Terminal panes with a file manager and system monitor in a project workspace

description.p: Release-candidate preparation for desktop artwork and integration corrections.

ul.li: Use the approved square Among mark for desktop application icons.
Associate AppImageLauncher-launched Wayland windows with their generated desktop entry without changing the global application identity.
Supply a public application screenshot and documentation link in AppStream metadata.
Keep release notes bound to each package version, including release candidates.
Resolve an existing AppImageLauncher entry when opening its registered file without desktop-launch hints.
Provide raster icon sizes for AppImageLauncher file thumbnails instead of relying on its SVG thumbnail renderer.

description.p: Terminal workflow fixes and a quieter, resizable sidebar.

ul.li: Resize the expanded sidebar and remember its width across restarts.
Keep diagnostics without bottom pop-up messages.
Inherit the originating pane's directory when splitting a terminal.
Calibrate touchpad scrolling and rename workspaces on a double-click.

description.p: Initial local release preparation; distribution is not yet published.
